name: Tanikaze Yuzuki
source:
Riku and Amane's mother.

A great mom to both of her children, and a loving wife to her husband. She's always positive and upbeat.

Given that she also works full-time, the housework often falls to Riku and Amane (though Riku handles the vast majority of it).

[Translated from the [url=https://www.yuzu-soft.com/products/ten_sz/]official website[/url]]
